$doc: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for `items.schema_ref` in the shared impress-core store.
The store matches `schema_ref` by EXACT EQUALITY (crates/impress-core/src/sql_query.rs).
No version tolerance, no namespace fallback, no fuzzy match. A reader that spells a
ref differently from its writer returns ZERO ROWS forever, silently, on every platform.
That failure mode is indistinguishable from 'the user has no data yet', which is why it
has shipped repeatedly and survived both code review and CI.
THE RULE: one canonical spelling per record kind, listed once here. Every schema-ref
string literal in the tree (Rust and Swift) must equal one of these. Enforced by
THERE IS NO NAMING CONVENTION TO INFER. Bare (`manuscript`), namespaced (`imbib/library`,
`core/operation`) and versioned (`task@1.0.0`) spellings all exist and all are correct for

canonical.agent-run: impress-core registry. Bare form; see knownDivergences/impel-run-spelling.
canonical.agent-run@1.0.0: VERSIONED. Written by impel-core task_store AGENT_RUN_SCHEMA; claimed by AgentRunRecordKind descriptor and the agentRunsAll sidebar count.
canonical.annotation: impress-core. Written by imbib annotation sync.
canonical.chat-message: impress-core + impart-core. Written by impart ImpartStoreAdapter.
canonical.citation-usage: impress-core. Written BARE by imprint ImprintStoreAdapter.recordCitationUsage. Read by imprint ImprintImpressStore + imbib CitationUsageReader.
canonical.core/operation: imbib-core registry; written by impress-core sqlite_store operation journal. NOT `impress/operation` — see knownDivergences/operation-spelling.
canonical.dataset: impress-core (implore schemas). Written by implore ImploreStoreAdapter.
canonical.figure: impress-core (implore schemas). Written by implore ImploreStoreAdapter.
canonical.imbib/bibliography-entry: imbib-core. THE publication ref. Written by imbib-core conversion.rs:113. Reading bare `bibliography-entry` is the iOS-citation-picker bug. Also the impel enrichment spawn trigger (impel-enrichment BIBLIOGRAPHY_ENTRY_SCHEMA, scanned by impel-taskd): that constant read `bibliography-entry@1.0.0` until 2026-07-29, so the pipeline matched zero rows and never spawned a task — fixed, and pinned against this writer by `enrichment_trigger_matches_the_ref_imbib_actually_writes`.
canonical.impel/agent-run: impel-core registry; written by impel SharedTaskBridge.swift. See knownDivergences/impel-run-spelling.
canonical.impel/task: impel-core registry; written by impel SharedTaskBridge.swift. See knownDivergences/impel-task-spelling.
canonical.manuscript: impress-core + imbib-core. Written by imprint ManuscriptStoreAdapter, impel JournalPipeline.
canonical.manuscript-collection: impress-core + imbib-core. Manuscript folder envelope; written by imprint ManuscriptMigrationRunner.
canonical.manuscript-revision: impress-core + imbib-core. Written by impel JournalSnapshotJob.
canonical.manuscript-section: impress-core + imbib-core. Written BARE by imprint ImprintStoreAdapter.syncSections (Swift, gated on hasThroughline) and crates/imprint-service/src/sections.rs SECTION_SCHEMA_REF (Rust, app-closed/MCP path). Reading `manuscript-section@1.0.0` was the outline/sections/cross-doc-search bug.
canonical.review: impress-core knowledge objects. Written by impel JournalReviewService.
canonical.review-request@1.0.0: VERSIONED, and in NO registry. Written by impel-core task_store REVIEW_REQUEST_SCHEMA, validated by impress-store-ffi resolve_review, read by imprint ThroughlineCoordinator. Canonical because it is genuinely the written spelling; the missing registration is tracked in registeredButUnwritten's inverse and is why registry.validate() is a no-op for these rows.
canonical.revision-note: impress-core knowledge objects. Written by impel JournalReviewService.
canonical.task: impress-core registry. Bare form; see knownDivergences/impel-task-spelling.
canonical.task@1.0.0: VERSIONED. Written by impel-core task_spawn TASK_SCHEMA; selected by impress-core sqlite_store ready_tasks; claimed by TaskRecordKind descriptor and the agentTasksAll sidebar counts.

$registriesDoc: Exactly what each crate's schema-registration entry point produces. Asserted in BOTH
directions by crates/<crate>/tests/schema_ref_manifest.rs — a new, renamed or dropped
schema fails its crate's test until this list is updated in the same PR. Per-crate so
no new dependency edges are needed to make each direction total.

registeredButUnwritten.impress/operation: impress-core registers this id, but sqlite_store writes the operation journal as `core/operation` (which imbib-core registers). Nothing has ever written or read `impress/operation`. Using it at a call site is always a bug.

literalAllowlist.not-a-manuscript-section: Negative fixture — ImprintImpressStoreTests asserts loadSection REJECTS a wrong-schema row.
literalAllowlist.s: Opaque placeholder in SyncEngineCodecTests round-trip; the codec never interprets it.
literalAllowlist.nothing: impress-store-ffi fixture asserting count_by_schema returns 0 for an unknown schema.
literalAllowlist.preprint: impress-core registry unit-test fixture for validate-unknown-schema.
literalAllowlist.publication@1.0.0: impress-core backup.rs unit-test fixture; the backup format stores whatever ref a row carries, so the value is arbitrary here.
literalAllowlist.manuscript-bundle-manifest@1.0.0: NOT a store schema_ref. This is the self-describing `schema` field INSIDE a bundle-manifest JSON payload (impress-core schemas/manuscript_bundle_manifest.rs), which is versioned by design. No row is ever written with this ref.
literalAllowlist.manuscript-bundle-manifest@2.0.0: Same as above — a CounselEngine test asserting an unknown manifest payload version is rejected.

knownDivergences.why: THREE live spellings for one kind. impel-core's REGISTRY says `impel/task`; its KERNEL (task_spawn.rs TASK_SCHEMA) writes `task@1.0.0`; impress-core registers a bare `task` nothing writes; impel's Swift SharedTaskBridge writes `impel/task`. sqlite_store.ready_tasks selects ONLY `task@1.0.0`, so bridge-written tasks are never scheduled, and registry.validate() cannot validate kernel-written tasks at all. Not fixed here: needs a data migration over existing user stores plus an owner decision on which spelling wins.
Same split as impel-task-spelling, for agent runs. The agentRunsAll sidebar count reads `agent-run@1.0.0` only.

sqlite_store writes and queries `core/operation`; imbib-core registers that id. impress-core's schemas/operation.rs registers `impress/operation`, which nothing writes or reads. Harmless today (writer and reader agree), but the dead registration is a trap for the next reader.
